## Objective

Observe the pinned backend in isolated fixtures and bounded root context, then decide conditional enablement.

## Scope

- Provision the explicitly authorized local pilot
- Run isolated backend compatibility scenarios
- Run the bounded active-root backend pilot
- Measure the pilot operating profile
- Record compatibility and conditional enablement

## Entry conditions

- Exact local package/model provisioning authority and reviewed runtime profile are present.

## Exit criteria

- Every mandatory pilot scenario has an actual or explicitly classified result.
- Compatibility decision and effective root enabled/disabled state agree; failures preserve fallback.

## Risks

- Serialize shared-file edits and honor every task-specific authority, preservation and evidence gate.

## TASK-039 - Provision the explicitly authorized local pilot

After separate runtime/model authorization is present, provision the reviewed pinned backend in .venv-memory-pilot and its local model cache, preserving root .venv ownership. Configure isolated fixture and root pilot profiles; keep persistent root semantic enablement disabled and expose only the guarded adapter.

### Risks

- If runtime or model installation authority is absent, stop this task with that exact gate; do not install through a read or setup command.

### Acceptance criteria

- Actual package/model artifacts, interpreter, effective project/config/routing and disabled automatic behaviors match the reviewed manifest.
- The pilot uses local resources only; ordinary reads/setup trigger no provisioning and no host-wide unrestricted MCP server is registered.

### Planned verification

- Check installed version/artifact hashes and effective configuration against the pinned profile.
- Observe the actual exposed adapter/backend tool set, disabled cloud routing and no automatic download/update after provisioning.

- A failed compatibility scenario is not an enablement pass; stop dependent unsafe live-root experiments and retain the failure evidence.

### Risks

- A successful small fixture run is not proof of root behavior; record the actual bounded root corpus size and all unexercised scale limits.

### Acceptance criteria

- The bounded root context has observed canonical preservation, project isolation, source provenance, mode disclosure, controlled rebuild and outage fallback.
- If isolated safety blocks this run, the root result remains explicitly unexercised and semantic use stays disabled; no unsafe scenario is forced on live history.

### Planned verification

- Record actual root queries, selected source/note hashes and projected/indexed scope before and after indexing/search.
- Disable/unavailable backend and verify lexical/direct recall plus governed-file mtime/byte preservation.

### Risks

- A negative pilot conclusion can complete the evaluation but cannot be reported as successful Basic Memory adoption or erase unmet behavior.

### Acceptance criteria

- The decision cites actual checks and tested versions and distinguishes completed evaluation, compatible adoption and enabled root behavior.
- Any failed, blocked or incomplete mandatory pilot check leaves semantic use off, preserves lexical/direct reads and remains visible in release evidence.

### Planned verification

- Audit every mandatory matrix result and exact profile hash before deciding enablement.
- Reopen effective root config and run actual health/lookup in its resulting enabled-or-disabled state without side effects.
